## Purpose
A one-off developer script that prints the tasks of the most recent Mistral Workflows execution.

## Responsibilities
`main()` lists 5 executions, takes the first, prints its id and status, then `GET …/executions/{id}/tasks`.

## Key elements
`main`.

## Control flow
Runs under `__main__`.

## Data, state and side effects
Read-only HTTP calls.

## Configuration
`MISTRAL_API_KEY`.

## Interactions
`app.config.settings`.

## Error handling and edge cases
Prints a failed tasks call. With no executions it does nothing.

## Nuances and gotchas
A debugging leftover; see `check_stuck.py`.

## How to rebuild this file
Optional.

## Tests
None.
